title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 6 in D minor

character.text: Galant fughetta; a stretto fugue on a subject in two halves

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: the opening of the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 15–16).

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times). Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times). Returns in Episode 5 (bars 21–24).

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor (Alto); Subject in A minor (Soprano)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 7–10) in part, with alto and bass exchanged, a step lower. Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor, inverted (Alto); Subject in G minor, inverted, rhythm varied (Bass)
Stretto: Subject in G minor, rhythm varied (Bass); Subject in G minor (Soprano)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject, inverted (2 times). Alto: the opening of the subject, inverted. Bass: the opening of the subject, inverted (3 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor, inverted (Bass); Subject in D minor (Soprano)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 12–13) in part, with soprano and alto exchanged, a fifth lower. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times). Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every beat. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (5 times).

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor (Alto); Subject in D minor, inverted (Bass); Subject in D minor (Soprano)

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted.
